newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan to deport Spanish woman AIDS sufferer.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan to deport Spanish woman AIDS sufferer.

text.p: A Spanish woman suffering from AIDS will be deported to Barcelona on Sunday following a Pakistani court's acquittal of her on a drug-smuggling charge, a local weflare agency said on Wednesday.
"We have arranged her air ticket and she will now be flown to Barcelona on Sunday," the spokesman for Burney Welfare Trust said.
Police are deporting the woman, Luisa Maria Martin, because she lacks travel documents.
Martin, who says she has a four-year-old daughter in Spain, was arrested at Karachi airport with a boyfriend, Dominguez Rodriguez, in January last year and accused of carrying heroin.
She was acquitted on January 7 by a local court and released from jail custody to be sent to a hospital. Rodriguez was sentenced to eight years for carrying heroin, the spokesman said.
